notes.title: Trade Empire - Dev Diary #3 - Danger Zones
notes.notes: [p]Greetings everyone ![/p][p]Special markers have been created for the danger zones in the game. Each danger will be indicated with a unique icon. You can learn about the danger by clicking on the danger zone.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45701747/aa0ce028e903e302a1df8d6495edf899cf7e0ba3.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45701747/391ea9440bf7b661d9fa3642e359e85ee6cbd0c9.png"][/img][/p][p]The danger zones displayed in the demo version are :[/p][p]·         Pirate Threat (Sea)[/p][p]·         Bandit Threat (Land)[/p][p]·         Epidemic Disease (Land)[/p][p]·         War Zone (Sea / Land)[/p][p]·         Severe Weather (Sea / Land)[/p][p]You can reach us on social media for your suggestions.[/p]

notes.title: Trade Empire - Dev Diary #2 - Landmarks
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone ![/p][p]Cities in the game will no longer be represented by red dots, but rather by a single landmark for each city.[/p][p][/p][p]Structures to be used for the demo version :[/p][p]·         [b]Antioch[/b] [i](Cave-Church of St.Peter)[/i][/p][p]·         [b]Athenea[/b] [i](Parthenon)[/i][/p][p]·         [b]Constantinople[/b] [i](Hagia Sophia)[/i][/p][p]·         [b]Cyprus[/b] [i](Kyrenia Castle)[/i][/p][p]·         [b]Ephesus[/b] [i](Library of Celcus)[/i][/p][p]·         [b]Iconium[/b] [i](Iconium City Walls)[/i][/p][p]·         [b]Kriti[/b] [i](Knossos Palace)[/i][/p][p]·         [b]Rhodos[/b] [i](Colossus of Rhodos)[/i][/p][p]·         [b]Thessalonica[/b] [i](Rotunda)[/i][/p][p]·         [b]Tobruq[/b] [i](Berber Village)[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45701747/4f14bef422b7a8442abc3f89e5a54d0e543fd68a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]You can reach us on social media for your suggestions.[/p]

notes.title: Trade Empire - Dev Diary #1 - Diplomacy System
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone ![/p][p]The diplomacy system that will determine the fate of the trade has been completed.[/p][p]Your relations with cities are shaped by your [b]“Prestige”[/b], [b]“Influence”[/b], [b]“Trust”[/b] and [b]“Favor”[/b] values.[/p][p]Each action has a cost and a cooldown. Outcomes can be single or multi-outcome.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45701747/55d94bbde071a147a9a7b3946c9225dada834fea.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Effects of gameplay :[/b][/p][p]·         Taxes and prices may temporarily change.[/p][p]·         Trade rights and locked quests can be unlocked.[/p][p]·         Poor choices may lead to stat losses or restrictions.[/p][p]You can share your gameplay ideas via our social media channels.[/p]

notes.title: DEVELOPER'S ROUTE !
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45701747/8f1057fdff896dc8993b2feb54242d09b6c9dab7.png"][/img][/p][p]Greetings everyone![/p][p]As you know, unfortunately, there aren't any gameplay videos or many visuals available for the game.[/p][p]I'd like to announce that I'm planning to work on this.[/p][p]The game's map doesn't feel alive enough at the moment.[/p][p]Therefore, I don't think I have enough material to upload a gameplay video yet.[/p][p]However, this isn't an obstacle.[/p][p]I'm here to let you know that I'm always open to your ideas and will do my best to enhance the player experience.[/p][p]You can share your ideas with me on social media or through the Discord channel.[/p][p]-Goker[/p]
